responsibility: This header declares the mc-boot runtime interface for formatted REAL, LONGREAL, and LONGINT text I/O. It exposes read/write procedures and string conversion entry points for fixed-width floating-point and long-integer formatting, serving as the public contract above the lower-level StringConvert routines.
same_name_distinction: Defines the public floating-point and long-integer text I/O interface, whereas GFpuIO.cc contains the stream-facing implementations and the actual delegation to StrIO and StringConvert.
